g.text: Warm-started from our rule-based bot, then trained with PPO against itself and an evolved rival. 95% intervals; 800 games per point.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: * Evolved champion: made by evolutionary program synthesis [read: Claude keeps rewriting the bot and we keep whatever wins]; shown with trading off, since the bot can't trade.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: The bot never proposes laws, talks or trades with players; it votes by the rule-based bot's rule. Wins on 10-round worlds come at the round limit and don't count as strength.
